verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so snoozing and follow-up reminders are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents only label management, read/unread, archive, delete, drafts and AI chat. None of it mentions snoozing threads, scheduled resurfacing, or no-reply follow-up reminders. Label and read/unread controls are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
